name: Almighty Insane Popes Nation
description: The Almighty Insane Popes Nation is a predominantly European-American street gang founded in the late 1950s on Chicago's North Side, originating from a Greek greaser group at Lawrence and Rockwell who clashed with the Latin Kings. Rather than merging with the Simon City Royals, they formed their own gang — the name standing for 'Protecting Our People Eliminating Scum' — and joined the Folk Nation alliance in 1978. At their peak in the mid-1960s to early 1970s they had an estimated 300–500 members drawn from Polish, German, Irish, and Scandinavian communities in Albany Park, Portage Park, and Jefferson Park, and remain closely allied with the Simon City Royals and Imperial Gangsters.
